criteria_notes.note: test_body_over_limit checks a plain-text 413 'Content Too Large' for a body with Content-Length. test_streaming_body_without_content_length covers a chunked body with no Content-Length. test_multipart_counts_encoding_overhead covers a multipart file whose data is exactly at the limit but whose boundaries and headers push it over.

test_declared_content_length_rejected_before_reading checks the app is never called. test_understated_content_length_does_not_bypass checks the received-byte count still enforces the limit. test_body_exactly_at_limit checks a body exactly at the limit returns 200. test_invalid_content_length_is_ignored covers a non-numeric header.
test_no_second_response_when_response_already_started checks that only the app's http.response.start is sent and that RequestBodyLimitExceeded still propagates.
test_not_exported_from_package_root checks the middleware is not an attribute of the starlette package. I did not touch starlette/__init__.py.
